title: Re-rank output document (stdout of a custom command; ranking.json of the bundled implementation)
description: Exactly these keys. ranking plus excluded must equal the candidate key set exactly. The document is at most 32 KiB (a limit JSON Schema cannot express; ticket-queue checks it before parsing). A reason longer than 200 characters is cut by ticket-queue, not rejected (maxLength is the author's contract). skill_marker follows the marker rule of the interface (the key set below allows it; ticket-queue enforces presence).

skill_marker.description: Present and equal to the effective rerank.marker when the bundled implementation runs with a marker; absent when the marker is null; a custom rerank.command must not print it.
